641:t_016:13.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Though back then, I was off on a carefree journey, all on my own.」

641:t_016:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Why did you stand against $$ジェミニス$$... against the $$サイデリアル$$?」

641:t_016:15.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「We are the superiors of the $$サイデリアル$$. It falls to us to guide them, $$スフィア・リアクター$$s included, so that they grow strong.」

641:t_016:16.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is why I chose to become an obstacle. And the same goes for you.」

641:t_016:18.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is why, sometimes as an ally and sometimes as an enemy, I have guided you to the truth.」

641:t_016:19.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「As a result, you overthrew the $$新地球皇国$$, and were even able to come face to face with the $$御使い$$s like this.」

641:t_016:21.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Are you dissatisfied, $$ドクトリン$$?」

641:t_016:22.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「No... I, too, have broken free of the past.」

641:t_016:23.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's the spirit. Let me thank you for your toil in my absence.」

641:t_016:24.en:
$$カレン$$
「Is that how you treated $n as your own property, too, twisting his fate however you pleased!?」

641:t_016:25.en:
$$赤木$$
「So you've been pulling strings to make sure he'd grow into a $$スフィア・リアクター$$!?」

641:t_016:26.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I am no god, so I cannot go that far. His contact with the $$いがみ合う双子$$ was the result of several coincidences piling up.」

641:t_016:27.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「And my interest in him stems from his mother.」

641:t_016:29.en:
$$トライア$$
「$n's mother... So that's Dr. $$メグミ・ラクナルド$$.」

641:t_016:30.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「She was a brilliant person.」

641:t_016:31.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「By combining super-dimensional physics with archaeology, she sought to reach the existence of the $$御使い$$s on her own, through the ruins of a prehistoric civilization.」

641:t_016:32.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is why I punished her.」

641:t_016:34.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I gave her despair, and steered her into taking the life of her beloved son.」

641:t_016:35.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「What astonished me came after that. By sheer force of will, she overcame despair and hope alike, and protected her son by ending her own life.」

641:t_016:36.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So that's the truth behind your mother's death, $n...」

641:t_016:37.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「After that, I took an interest in that son... in other words, $F.」

641:t_016:38.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I thought that perhaps, if I gave him despair as well, he might gain the power to overcome hope and despair like his mother...」

641:t_016:39.en:
$$シン$$
「And for that, you took $n's dad and sister!!」

641:t_016:41.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「And to think that he would then meet the $$いがみ合う双子$$. That is why the world is so interesting.」

641:t_016:42.en:
$$桂$$
「That guy has been toying with $n's fate...」

641:t_016:43.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Scum! What right do you have!?」

641:t_016:44.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It is nothing so special. There are about 93,274 children in the whole universe who have been subjects of my experiments, as he was.」

641:t_016:45.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$n, the fruit of all that... You are worthy of receiving my love.」

641:t_016:46.en:
$n
「...Thanks for telling me something good, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...」

641:t_016:48.en:
$$葵$$
「You're not... You're not going to give in to that guy's power, are you...!?」

641:t_016:49.en:
$n
「Mom was still my mom after all... I don't have to hate her or be afraid of her anymore... right...」

641:t_016:51.en:
$n
「I won't forgive you! You took Dad's life, and Sis's, and... Mom's too! I won't forgive you!!」

641:t_016:52.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「That one... has shaken off the proof of his blood by his own will.」

641:t_016:53.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Isn't he fun, that kid?」

641:t_016:54.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But that is not a story limited to $n alone.」

641:t_016:55.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$c... and furthermore, everyone living on that Earth is striving to reach the radiance of the sun.」

641:t_016:56.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「So we must pass judgment after all.」

641:t_016:57.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Shut your mouth! You bunch of villains!」

641:t_016:58.en:
$$万丈$$
「I bet that 'judgment' of yours is just a forced execution, with no defense counsel and no hearing for our side.」

641:t_016:59.en:
$$刹那$$
「Then we'll resist with everything we have! To protect our future, too!」

641:t_016:61.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Perfect. The preparations for the $$メイオール$$ Galaxy of the 23rd world are complete.」

641:t_016:62.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「We can pull it off there even in its current state.」

641:t_016:64.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「We are the $$御使い$$s... wielders of the power of the Supreme God.」

641:t_016:65.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We oversee the fate of every living thing in every world, and if need be, we pass judgment.」

641:t_016:66.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「We'll send the images straight into your brains.」

641:t_016:67.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The moment a single galaxy vanishes.」

641:t_017:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「It's a bluff! It's got to be a trick to scare us!」

641:t_017:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've confirmed it by super-dimensional observation...! That footage... really happened!」

641:t_017:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「A whole galaxy... vanishing this easily...」

641:t_017:8.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't like it. Only three of them, and they do something like that as casually as yanking out weeds...!」

641:t_017:9.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Do not mistake this, $$始原の特異点$$. I carry it out as my duty, under a powerful anger.」

641:t_017:10.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Though $$テンプティ$$ does it because it's fun.」

641:t_017:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「True, looked at as an act, it is destruction, but it is necessary to save the universe as a whole.」

641:t_017:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I feel the joy of having delivered it.」

641:t_017:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「No more words are needed! You are devils who toy with the fates and lives of others!」

641:t_017:15.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The word 'devil' is what $$バアル$$ deserves.」

641:t_017:16.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Whoever stands against them and protects the future of the universe... that one alone is worthy of calling themselves a god.」

641:t_017:17.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「The $$御使い$$s are that god's messengers.」

641:t_017:18.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, steel yourselves! We can't let them run loose!」

641:t_017:19.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「That is the enemy of everything alive...!」

641:t_017:20.en:
$$號$$
「They are the fundamental calamity... The worst enemy waiting at the end of evolution!」

641:t_017:21.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That fighting spirit... Though it comes from ignorance, it is admirable indeed.」

641:t_017:22.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「But the ones who'll be your opponents aren't $$テンプティ$$ and the others.」

641:t_017:23.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We came here to awaken the system that sleeps at the poles.」

メグミ・ラクナルド.evidence: Traia: $nの母親...メグミ・ラクナルド博士 (Hibiki's late mother, researcher); not in glossary (the メグミ token exists alone); Lacnald is my romanization of ラクナルド
